convention.frame: each camera's own MuJoCo frame (x right, y up, looking along -z); applied to the camera's mount pose relative to its parent body (agentview: mobilebase0_support, eye_in_hand: robot0_right_hand)
convention.rotation: R_new = R_mount @ Ry(yaw) @ Rx(pitch) @ Rz(roll); positive yaw = turn left, positive pitch = tilt up, positive roll = CCW about the view axis (as seen from behind the camera)
convention.back_m: translation along the camera's own +z (away from the scene)
convention.unchanged: fovy, resolution (256x256), no 2D image ops, no recentering
convention.status: PROVISIONAL until the keti parity check passes (lanai sign conventions)
